title: Code-along: Build powerful drag and drop in SwiftUI
description: Follow along as we build a game of Solitaire to explore the latest drag-and-drop capabilities in SwiftUI. We’ll show you how to use the new reordering API to let people arrange content, implement drag containers to move multiple items at once, and customize the drag-and-drop lifecycle to fit your app’s rules. To get the most out of this session, watch “Meet Transferable” from WWDC22.
